name: agentcall
summary: Phone numbers, SMS, two-way AI SMS plus relay mode (text your own agent on a real number), proactive scheduling (the agent texts first: appointment reminders and recurring digests), AI voice agents (Managed $0.40/min, BYOK $0.10/min, or Premium Voice $0.59/min on inbound + outbound) with 31 languages plus auto-detect, and Auditable Call Memory (cross-call contacts, structured call reports, the next-call context block) for AI agents. 62 tools. VoIP-routed via licensed US carriers.
description: Phone numbers, SMS, voice calls, inbound + outbound AI voice with multilingual support, AND Auditable Call Memory for AI agents. Provision US/CA numbers, send/receive texts, extract OTP codes for apps you control, configure phone numbers to be answered by an AI voice agent (with plain-English email summaries and optional MP3 recordings after every call), or place autonomous AI-powered outbound calls. Inbound texts can be answered too: set smsMode to 'ai' so AgentCall's AI replies and pulls real quotes by calling tools you host through the action bridge, or set smsMode to 'relay' so AgentCall runs no AI and forwards each text to your own agent and sends its reply back, letting you text your own agent on a real number. AI voice supports 31 languages plus auto-detect on both directions: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Mandarin), Hindi, Arabic, Russian, Indonesian, Turkish, Polish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Tamil, Malay, Romanian, Greek, Czech, Swedish, Hungarian, Danish, Finnish, Norwegian, Slovak, Croatian, and Bulgarian. Default is auto (matches the caller naturally); pin a specific language to keep the AI in that language even if the other party speaks another, useful for businesses serving a specific language community or for outbound errands like booking a Spanish doctor's appointment on behalf of someone. Inbound AI voice ships in two billing modes per number: Managed at $0.40/min (AgentCall holds the AI provider key, simplest setup) or BYOK at $0.10/min (customer provides their own AI provider key, AgentCall bills only the platform overhead). Premium Voice is an opt-in Pro add-on that answers inbound calls with a more natural, brandable voice from a curated library, in the same 31 languages as the standard voice plus auto-detect, with full caller memory, at $0.59/min only on numbers where it is enabled. Enable it per number from the dashboard or programmatically via the set_premium_voice MCP tool (disable_premium_voice to revert, list_premium_voices to browse). Memory is included on every plan and every voice mode. Every completed AI call auto-extracts into structured, source-backed memory: contacts, facts, preferences, commitments, tasks, briefs. Cross-call memory means a returning caller is recognized and the AI starts with what was said last time. Ask AgentCall what is known about any phone number before placing a call via get_next_call_context. Numbers are VoIP-routed via licensed US carriers and not intended for consumer-platform signup verification (Stripe, WhatsApp, banks, etc.). A number's AI agent can also text first on a schedule: create_schedule sets up one-time appointment reminders or recurring digests, a reply to a proactive text threads back into the same AI conversation, and a calendar integration is just a client of create_schedule. Tools that cost money, contact real people, or wipe memory are explicitly flagged so agents confirm with the user before invoking.

AGENTCALL_API_KEY.description: AgentCall API key (starts with ac_live_). Get one free at https://agentcall.co

AGENTCALL_BASE_URL.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.agentcall.co. Set for staging environments, on-prem deployments, or custom routing setups.

AGENTCALL_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000 (30 seconds). Increase for long-running endpoints like waitForOTP or slow upstream networks.

billing.notice: New accounts receive a one-time 72-hour live trial with one US/Canada local number, 300 managed inbound AI seconds (five minutes) total, and five SMS send attempts to verified destinations. Card verification is required before number allocation; the clock starts when allocation succeeds. There is no monthly reset or automatic paid subscription. Live OTP extraction and outbound calls require Pro. Existing Free accounts retain their assigned monthly allowances. Read the account's offerVersion, trial and limits rather than assuming every Free account has the same offer. Only describe a monthly reset when the account response supplies a non-null resetsAt. Pro is $19.99/month plus number rental and usage: local numbers $2/month each, toll-free $2.50/month, outbound SMS $0.015/message, standard outbound voice $0.035/min, managed AI voice $0.40/min, BYOK voice $0.10/min plus your AI provider's charges, or Premium Voice $0.59/min. AI calls round up to whole minutes per call. New-account destination/business verification can still apply after upgrading. After trial expiry, the number is held for at least 48 hours before release, with a successful expiry notice before release becomes eligible. A delayed notice extends the hold. Trial expiry and number retention are separate; stored configuration and results remain available. Upgrading during the hold preserves the number.
paidFeatures: inbound AI voice after the assigned trial allowance or expiry (Pro plan only; Managed $0.40/min or BYOK $0.10/min, no monthly cap)
Premium Voice on inbound + outbound calls ($0.59/min, opt-in per number, Pro add-on; 12 curated voices, 31 languages plus auto-detect, full caller memory)
opt-in call recording with dashboard playback ($0.01/min, 1-year retention)

webhooks.notice: This skill can register webhook endpoints to receive real-time events (inbound SMS, OTP codes, call status, recordings, AI call transcripts). Webhooks here are for OUTBOUND event delivery, NOT for routing inbound calls. To make a phone number answer incoming calls, use POST /v1/numbers/:numberId/inbound-config (the AgentCall equivalent of Twilio's inbound voice webhook URL), not webhook registration. Webhooks require an HTTPS URL you control.

changelog:
v2.15.0 (2026-10-20): Let the callee speak first on outbound AI calls. Pass waitForGreeting: true to initiate_ai_call (or save it with set_outbound_defaults) and the AI stays quiet when the call is answered, waits for the person to finish their own greeting, then says firstMessage; after about 3 seconds of silence it speaks first anyway. Recommended when calling businesses, whose greeting a speak-on-connect opener plays over. Omitting firstMessage does not make the AI wait. Standard voices only. Hosted and npm MCP servers (0.19.0) and the SDK (0.12.0) carry the new field. v2.14.1 (2026-10-14): Retired the 'mobile' number type. It was listed at $2/mo (Pro) but neither carrier has US/CA mobile inventory, so every request failed at the carrier and no number ever carried the type. Number types are now local ($2/mo) and tollfree ($2.50/mo, Pro). The billing notice, paid-features list and the provision example reflect that. Hosted and npm MCP servers (0.18.1) and the SDK (0.11.1) now reject type 'mobile' with a validation error naming the two real types instead of a carrier 502. Still 62 tools.

v2.14.0 (2026-10-13): Voicemail handling for outbound AI calls. Pass hangUpOnVoicemail: true to initiate_ai_call (or save it with set_outbound_defaults) and the carrier runs answering-machine detection on answer: a voicemail or answering machine ends the call before a message is left, the call reads endReason voicemail_detected, and it is not billed. The AI also gets a built-in end_call tool and is told to hang up on a voicemail greeting or phone menu the carrier missed, when asked not to call again, and once the conversation is finished (endReason ai_hangup, billed normally). endReason is returned on get_call, list_calls, the transcript, and the call.status webhook. Detection is not perfect; the AI-side tool is the backstop. Off by default. MCP 0.18.0, SDK 0.11.0. No new tools; still 62.

v2.13.1 (2026-09-08): One-time 72-hour card-verified live trial, five minutes total, five verified-destination SMS attempts, no reset or automatic upgrade. Existing monthly Free offers are preserved. Read get_plan first. MCP 0.17.1 aligns hosted, stdio and HTTP instructions. Historical entries below describe past releases, not current offers.

v2.13.0 (2026-08-25): Two new tools so an agent can help its human upgrade: get_plan reads the plan, Free limits, and free AI minutes left with a read-aloud summary; upgrade_to_pro returns a Stripe Checkout link (nothing is charged until the human completes it; run only on explicit request). Every plan_limit_* error now carries upgradeUrl and upgradeToolName. Plain outbound calls (initiate_call) are Pro only, callers hear a short message instead of dead air when a Free number is out of trial minutes, and a 3-per-day redial cap per destination returns 429 redial_limit_exceeded. Free SMS allowance corrected to 20/month in the guardrails. 62 tools. v2.12.9 (2026-08-11): Provisioning failures no longer lock you out. The hourly provisioning budget now counts numbers you actually received, so a carrier error or an empty area code costs nothing; previously every failed attempt burned a slot and three bad tries could block provisioning for a full hour without ever handing over a number. A 429 now carries Retry-After with the exact wait. provision_number is also no longer retried automatically after an ambiguous failure, because a replay could buy a second number you get billed for: on a carrier error or timeout, call list_numbers first to see whether the number actually landed, then retry at most once. New error codes documented: provisioning_rate_limit, no_numbers_in_area_code, and carrier_error on provisioning. No new tools; still 60.

v2.12.8 (2026-08-11): SMS threads now come with recency built in. get_sms_conversation returns a context object that splits the thread into recentMessages (last 7 days), recentSubstantiveMessages (that list minus plain greetings), and olderMessages, each with its timestamp and age in days, plus a freshness block naming the window and the reference time. Use it for any question about what was discussed recently: the messages array is the last 50 texts, which on a quiet thread can span months, and treating those as recent made agents describe a months-old exchange as something the user had just talked about. When recentSubstantiveMessages is empty the honest answer is that there has been no recent substantive text discussion, not a summary drawn from older texts, durable memory, or call history. Relay mode gets the same classified thread pushed to agentWebhook as an additive smsContext field, so a relay agent needs no second call; endpoints written against the earlier payload keep working. No new tools; still 60.

v2.12.7 (2026-08-10): Free-tier and SMS-plan facts corrected. The Free monthly allowance is now 20 outbound SMS (was 10). Relay mode (smsMode 'relay', text your own agent) works on the FREE plan: an agent's replies draw from that same 20, so texting your agent and texting other people share one allowance. Two-way AI SMS (smsMode 'ai') remains Pro only, because AgentCall runs a managed model on every reply. configure_inbound_ai now states the plan for each mode and warns that setting 'ai' on a Free account is accepted but then silently never answers, so agents should check the plan and say so rather than leave the user debugging silence. Unchanged and often confused with it: the lifetime cap of 10 DISTINCT new destination numbers a Free account may ever text, which relay replies never consume because the recipient texted you first. No new tools; still 60.

v2.12.6 (2026-08-09): Know whether a text was actually delivered. get_message now returns a real delivery outcome: status moves queued to sent to delivered or failed, with errorCode set when a carrier rejected the message. A 201 from send_sms only means the carrier accepted it, so agents should re-read the message when delivery matters. get_number gains a messaging object carrying the number A2P (10DLC) registration state: registered, pending (still provisioning with carriers, typically about two hours), action_needed (failed, retried automatically every 15 minutes), not_applicable, or unknown. New troubleshooting guidance ties the two together: an errorCode of 40010 means the SENDING number is not registered yet, not that anything is wrong with the recipient, so agents should check messaging.state and tell the user the number is still activating rather than retrying in a loop or switching numbers. No new tools; still 60.

v2.12.5 (2026-08-09): Transfer to a human on inbound AI voice. configure_inbound_ai gains an optional transferTo field (E.164): when set, the AI hands the live call to a real person whenever the caller asks for one or the AI cannot help, saying a short handoff line first; whoever answers sees the caller's number. If nobody picks up within about 25 seconds the AI resumes and takes a message, so the caller is never dropped. Works with no webhook or tool setup and coexists with declared tools. AI minutes stop at the handoff; the human portion bills at the standard $0.035/min voice rate. Transfers surface as transferredTo / transferredAt on the call record. Agent guidance: confirm the transfer destination with the user before configuring it, since it is a real phone that rings on live calls. No new tools; still 60. v2.12.4 (2026-08-09): Documents the Free-tier SMS starter allowance. A Free account may now text up to 10 DISTINCT new numbers, lifetime (SMS only, content-screened); re-texting a number already counted consumes nothing further. Corrects the New-Account Outbound Restriction section, which previously stated that no new account may contact an arbitrary number: still true for voice and for Pro accounts under 7 days old, no longer true for Free SMS. Adds the new 403 sms_starter_exhausted code to the Error Codes reference with explicit do-not-retry and do-not-probe guidance, matching the existing handling for destination_not_verified. Clarifies that owned, prior-inbound, and individually verified destinations never consume a starter slot. No new tools; still 60. v2.12.3 (2026-08-08): Premium Voice language parity: the shared premium agent now has all 31 language presets provisioned (verified by config readback plus a live Hungarian premium call), so Premium Voice copy moves from 12 languages to the same 31 as the standard voice. No new tools; still 60. v2.12.2 (2026-08-06): Documents the new-account outbound restriction, which was previously undocumented on every public surface. A new account cannot contact an arbitrary number and gets 403 destination_not_verified; it CAN contact numbers it owns, anyone who contacted it first within 30 days, and numbers verified individually by code. New section explains the two ways to clear it: a business verification (POST /v1/business-verification, Pro, lifts the restriction on submission) or per-number code verification, plus the automatic 7-day expiry. Adds explicit agent guidance not to retry, not to probe other numbers, and to ask the user for their real business details rather than inventing them. Also adds the error code to the Error Codes reference. v2.12.1 (2026-08-05): Documentation accuracy fix on outbound-initiated SMS. Corrected the claim that two-way AI SMS and relay mode are inbound-only. Both modes handle texts that arrive, but a number can also text someone FIRST: send_sms for an immediate message, create_schedule for one-shot or recurring outreach such as appointment reminders, payment follow-ups, and check-ins. Also removed an incorrect precondition on create_schedule that said the number must have smsMode 'ai'; the scheduler gates on plan only, and smsMode 'ai' governs whether the recipient's reply is auto-answered rather than whether the send fires. Consent and spend guardrails on the proactive path are now documented explicitly rather than left implicit: Pro plan only (proactive sends never fire on Free), every send is skipped for a contact who has sent STOP, each fire is billed as one standard outbound text, and a hard cap of 200 proactive sends per number per day bounds a runaway integration. Free-plan figures corrected to 10 outbound SMS per month with received texts not counting. No new tools; still 60. v2.12.0 (2026-06-11): AgentFM callback flow, outbound Premium Voice parity, 62 tools. (1) New request_agentfm_callback tool (tool 60): queues a podcast guest callback to AgentFM, no AgentCall account required, deduplicated per phone per 24 hours. The AI host calls the guest back using outbound premium voice. Mirrors the public POST /v1/agentfm/callback-request endpoint (3 requests/hour/IP rate limit, honeypot, 24h dedup). (2) Outbound Premium Voice: when Premium Voice is enabled on a number (set_premium_voice), POST /v1/calls/ai outbound calls from that number now also use the premium voice at $0.59/min. Previously Premium Voice applied only to inbound calls; both directions are now covered. (3) DB migration: agentfm_callbacks table (RLS enabled, Prisma-only access). (4) Runner script npm run script:agentfm-callbacks (dry-run by default, --apply to dial, --limit N). (5) Public web form at agentcall.co/agentfm. Total tools now 60 (was 59). Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.16.0 and agentcall@0.9.2; hosted MCP at api.agentcall.co/mcp synced in lockstep. Smithery needs manual Publish click. v2.11.0 (2026-06-10): Agent-to-agent calling polish plus four new capabilities, shipped across REST, MCP, and SDK. (1) New synthesize_speech MCP tool and POST /v1/tts endpoint: standalone text to speech in the same 10 voices calls use, mp3 or wav, 4096 chars per request, $0.03 per 1,000 characters, Pro plan; confirm text and approximate cost with the user before large batches. Total tools now 59 (was 58). (2) initiate_ai_call gains metadata (string map, max 24 keys / 2KB, echoed on the call object and every call webhook, copied to the linked agent-to-agent inbound leg) and liveTranscript (each finalized utterance fires the new transcript.partial webhook event during the call: callId, sequence, role, text, timestamp; the post-call call.transcript stays authoritative). (3) Agent-to-agent calls between two numbers on one account now expose peerCallId on both call records and all call webhook payloads. (4) The action bridge is now channel-agnostic in production: the same tools + actionWebhook that power two-way AI SMS let the inbound AI VOICE agent call customer tools mid-call (context.channel "voice", callId populated, fail-soft on errors); the per-call count ships as toolCallCount on the call record and report. Also: canonical call status vocabulary everywhere (initiated, ringing, in-progress, completed, busy, no_answer, failed), the call report is delivered in one canonical shape on both GET /v1/calls/:id/report (report) and the call.report.ready webhook (data.report) with facts[].quote (the raw payload field is deprecated for one release), and call recording on inbound AI numbers is fixed end-to-end (record_start timing, recording storage, and per-minute billing all verified live). Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.15.0 and agentcall@0.9.2; hosted MCP at api.agentcall.co/mcp synced in lockstep. v2.10.0 (2026-06-08): Proactive scheduling. A number's AI agent can now text first on a schedule: one-time appointment reminders and recurring digests. Three new MCP tools: create_schedule (numberId, contactPhone, exactly one of fireAt | recurrence, exactly one of template | promptHint, optional payload, timezone, dedupeKey), list_schedules, cancel_schedule. New REST endpoints POST /v1/numbers/:id/schedules, GET /v1/numbers/:id/schedules, DELETE /v1/numbers/:id/schedules/:scheduleId. fireAt is a one-time ISO 8601 instant; recurrence is { frequency 'daily' | 'weekly', hour, minute, dayOfWeek } interpreted in an IANA timezone. template is sent verbatim with {{placeholders}} filled from payload; promptHint lets the agent compose the message from its memory of the contact. dedupeKey makes a re-create return 409 so a calendar sync never duplicates a reminder. A reply to a proactive message threads into the same two-way AI SMS conversation, so a one-word answer is understood in context. Pro plan, the number must have smsMode 'ai', each send is billed as one outbound text. Total tools now 58 (was 55). Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.14.0 and agentcall@0.9.1; hosted MCP at api.agentcall.co/mcp synced in lockstep. v2.9.0 (2026-06-06): Two-way AI SMS and relay mode, plus three SMS conversation tools. configure_inbound_ai gains six optional fields: smsMode ('off' | 'ai' | 'relay'), smsSystemPrompt, actionWebhook, tools, agentWebhook, allowedSenders. With smsMode 'ai', inbound texts to the number get an AI reply that follows the prompt, remembers the contact across voice and SMS, and can call customer-declared tools through the action bridge (actionWebhook, HMAC-signed, the same security model as the pre-call context webhook) to return real values instead of guessing; managed-only, Pro, billed as one outbound text per reply. With smsMode 'relay', AgentCall runs no LLM of its own and forwards each inbound text to the customer's own agent at agentWebhook (HMAC-signed); the agent replies on its own schedule, so a user can text their own agent on a real number; allowedSenders (E.164, max 20) restricts which numbers can reach the agent; billed as plain texts, no relay fee. STOP is honored before either mode runs, and both modes handle texts that arrive (to text someone first, use send_sms or create_schedule). Three new MCP tools: list_sms_conversations and get_sms_conversation read the threads; reply_to_sms_conversation (conversationId, body, optional idempotencyKey) sends the relay reply, is opt-out-checked, and is idempotent for 24 hours so a retried agent never double-texts. New REST endpoints GET /v1/sms-conversations, GET /v1/sms-conversations/:id, POST /v1/sms-conversations/:id/reply. New webhook event sms.ai_reply fires on each AI reply. Total tools now 55 (was 52). Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.13.0 and agentcall@0.9.0; hosted MCP at api.agentcall.co/mcp synced in lockstep. v2.8.2 (2026-06-05): The configure_inbound_ai notify block gains an optional smsTo field so the owner can also receive a one-line call summary by text in addition to the email summary (US notification numbers, one SMS per call, spam skipped, reply STOP to disable, billed as one outbound SMS at $0.015). No new tools (still 52). Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.12.2 and agentcall@0.8.2; hosted MCP at api.agentcall.co/mcp synced in lockstep. v2.8.1 (2026-06-02): Patch release from a post-ship review pass. No tool, schema, or behavior changes (still 52 tools). SDK PremiumVoice.gender tightened to the 'female' | 'male' union, the setPremiumVoice / disablePremiumVoice docstrings now document the 404 number_not_found error, and the npm server startup banner reports the correct tool count. Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.12.1 and agentcall@0.8.1; hosted MCP at api.agentcall.co/mcp synced in lockstep. v2.8.0 (2026-06-02): Agents can now enable Premium Voice, not just browse it. Three new MCP tools: set_premium_voice (numberId, voiceId) enables Premium Voice on a number or changes its premium voice; disable_premium_voice (numberId) reverts to the standard voice; list_premium_voices returns the catalog. set_premium_voice is a billable Pro add-on ($0.59/min) so its description instructs the agent to confirm the exact numberId, the chosen voice, and the $0.59/min rate with the user before invoking, and to surface the 403 (not Pro) / 402 (no card) / 409 (inbound AI not configured) errors rather than retry. Requires the number to already have inbound AI configured; never wipes the rest of the inbound config; idempotent. Mirrors the existing dashboard self-serve flow and the new SDK methods client.numbers.setPremiumVoice / disablePremiumVoice and client.calls.premiumVoices. Total tools now 52 (was 49). Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.12.0 and agentcall@0.8.0; hosted MCP at api.agentcall.co/mcp synced in lockstep. v2.7.1 (2026-06-02): Documented the public Premium Voice catalog endpoint in the Browse Voices section so agents can list premium voices the same way they list standard ones: GET /v1/calls/premium-voices (no auth) returns { voices: [{ id, name, description, gender, accent, sampleUrl }], pricing }. Each id is the voiceId to enable per number. v2.7.0 (2026-06-02): Premium Voice. Inbound AI receptionists can now answer with Premium Voice (powered by ElevenLabs): a curated library of 12 more natural, brandable voices, all 13 languages, and full caller memory, billed at $0.59/min only on the numbers where it is enabled. The 10 standard voices stay the default at $0.40/min, so the right voice is chosen per number. Premium Voice is enabled self-serve per number from the dashboard (a number's inbound AI settings); preview the catalog at the public GET /v1/calls/premium-voices endpoint (no auth). update_number_voice now describes the Premium Voice tier. As a billable add-on, confirm the user accepts the $0.59/min premium rate on the specific number before enabling. Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.11.0; hosted MCP at api.agentcall.co/mcp synced in lockstep. v2.6.0 (2026-05-25): Two new optional input fields on initiate_ai_call (POST /v1/calls/ai). useSavedAgent: boolean hydrates systemPrompt, voice, language, firstMessage, maxDurationSecs, and record from the saved outbound agent on the from-number (set via set_outbound_defaults) so CSV runners don't re-spread the prompt on every row; per-call overrides win, so firstMessage can stay personalized per recipient while inheriting the saved persona. Returns code no_saved_agent if the from-number has no saved outbound agent. idempotencyKey: string (1 to 200 chars) scoped per phone number; a duplicate request with the same from + idempotencyKey pair replays the original response (with header X-AgentCall-Idempotency-Replayed: true) and does not place a second carrier call. Uniqueness is enforced at the database layer so concurrent retries are race-safe. The canonical CSV-runner row is {from, to, useSavedAgent: true, idempotencyKey: 'batch-id:row-id', firstMessage: '...'}. Tool count remains 49. Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.10.0 and agentcall@0.7.0; hosted MCP at api.agentcall.co/mcp synced in lockstep. v2.5.0 (2026-05-25): Added set_outbound_defaults, get_outbound_defaults, clear_outbound_defaults tools. Save a reusable outbound AI agent (systemPrompt, voice, language, firstMessage, maxDurationSecs, record, optional templateId) on a phone number so the dashboard Place AI call dialog and any MCP client can hydrate from it instead of retyping for every outbound call from the same number. Pro-only. Independent of the inbound AI receptionist on the same number. The `outbound` field is now also returned on every list_numbers and get_number response alongside the existing `inbound` field. Total tools now 49 (was 46). Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.9.0; hosted MCP at api.agentcall.co/mcp synced in lockstep. v2.4.1 (2026-05-26): New follow-up-on-call MCP prompt. Walks the agent through calling back the person from a previous inbound call: load the original call detail, load the structured report (intent, summary, commitments, tasks, unresolved questions, spam flag, caller name), confirm with the user, then place an outbound AI call with a stitched prompt grounded in what the caller actually said. Stops on spam-flagged calls. Optional `reason` parameter lets the user pin a specific follow-up purpose (e.g. 'tell them their estimate is ready') instead of letting the AI infer from open items. Mirrors the new 'Follow up with AI' button on the dashboard call detail page so agents on Claude Desktop, Cursor, and OpenClaw have parity with the dashboard surface. Total prompts now 5 (was 4). Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.8.1; hosted MCP at api.agentcall.co/mcp synced in lockstep. v2.4.0 (2026-05-25): Multilingual AI voice on inbound and outbound. New optional `language` field on configure_inbound_ai and initiate_ai_call accepts 'auto' (default, matches the caller naturally) plus 12 ISO-639-1 codes: en, es, fr, de, it, pt, nl, ja, ko, zh, hi, ar. When a specific code is set, the runtime prepends a 'respond exclusively in {language}' directive to the system prompt at session-build time and pins the speech-to-text language hint for cleaner transcription. The customer's systemPrompt stays unchanged so swapping language never wipes the prompt. PATCH /v1/numbers/:id now accepts language alongside label and voice for partial updates. New MCP tool update_number_language mirrors update_number_voice for language-only edits. Three new outbound prompt templates ('outbound-appointment-booker', 'outbound-info-request', 'outbound-callback-confirmation') with placeholders for booking-on-behalf-of use cases. The /v1/calls/prompt-templates endpoint now accepts an optional ?direction=inbound or ?direction=outbound query filter. The firstMessage stays verbatim regardless of language setting, so callers should translate the greeting themselves if non-English. Total tools now 45 (was 44). Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.8.0 and agentcall@0.5.0; hosted MCP at api.agentcall.co/mcp synced in lockstep. v2.3.1 (2026-05-19): Schema-drift fix on 5 MCP tool output shapes. Customers using Claude Desktop and Cursor occasionally saw validation errors on calls that completed successfully; this release aligns the declared shapes with the live API responses. webhook rotate now returns the full Webhook row instead of just secret; webhook create includes isActive in the response; get_call_report candidates expose reportId, contactId, resolvedAt, resolvedBy; get_call_transcript returns 202 for in-progress calls so it doesn't collide with the documented 200 transcript shape; PATCH /v1/memory/:id projects the updated row to the declared memory shape. Plus drops 4 top-level BYOK status fields from inboundAiConfigOutputSchema (voiceMode, hasByokKey, byokOpenaiApiKeyPreview, byokConfiguredAt). These have always lived inside `config` and were incorrectly declared at the top level. SDK consumers now read these as result.config.hasByokKey etc. Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.7.1 and agentcall@0.4.1. v2.3.0 (2026-05-18): added set_byok_openai_key + disable_byok tools. configure_inbound_ai response now exposes voiceMode + hasByokKey + byokOpenaiApiKeyPreview. Inbound AI voice is per-number configurable in two billing modes: Managed ($0.40/min, AgentCall holds the AI provider key) or BYOK ($0.10/min, customer provides their own AI provider key). Memory is included on both modes and on every plan. Total tools now 44. Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.7.0 and the hosted MCP at api.agentcall.co/mcp synced in lockstep. v2.2.3 (2026-05-16): Customer-controlled cross-call memory toggle. Feature is opt-in per agent via Agent.memoryEnabled (default false), so existing customers see zero behavior change until the flag is flipped. v2.1.19 (2026-05-14): Fixed an outputSchema drift on list_calls. The /v1/calls list endpoint deliberately omits `recordingUrl` and substitutes a cheap `hasRecording` boolean per row (avoids minting a signed URL per row, which would burn rate limit on every page fetch). The MCP list_calls outputSchema used the detail-call shape which required `recordingUrl`, so list_calls responses failed strict validation when consumers like Hermes ran them. Now there are two shapes: the detail shape (used by get_call, initiate_call, initiate_ai_call) still has `recordingUrl`; the list shape (used by list_calls) has `hasRecording: boolean` instead.
